# Stuart Romanek

> Designer and engineer working on product, brand, and open source. Founding designer of ApostropheCMS.

Stuart Romanek's site is [romanek.us](https://romanek.us/). Contact: sdr@romanek.us. Open to new projects, people, and ideas.

## Work

- [ApostropheCMS](https://apostrophecms.com): Open source CMS and in-context editing tools
- [Louis](https://louis.romanek.us/): A Make Your Own studio that turns YouTube content into playlists for the Yoto player
- [Louis on GitHub](https://github.com/stuartromanek/louis): Source for Louis
- BLK MTN — identity and first major web release for an LA-based production and talent company
- The Andalusia Foundation — historic Biddle estate website (P'unk Avenue)
- The Orphan Disease Center — University of Pennsylvania / CHOP research site (P'unk Avenue)
- WRT — planners, urban designers, architects (P'unk Avenue)
- Center City District — Center City Philadelphia (P'unk Avenue)
